hazards.description: The presence of a large bus in the center lanes can block the view between pedestrians and drivers in adjacent lanes.

hazards.name: Poor Roadway Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily cracked and patched, which can lead to unpredictable vehicle movements and hazards for any pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the visible roadway surface in the foreground and midground

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control and Markings
hazards.description: The absence of lane markings and designated pedestrian crossings on a wide street can encourage higher vehicle speeds and makes pedestrian crossing maneuvers more dangerous.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration and lack of a median or refuge island create a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center and foreground of the roadway

hazards.name: High-speed road design
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes without traffic calming measures encourage higher vehicle speeds adjacent to a pedestrian plaza.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstructions
hazards.description: Parallel parked cars along the right curb can block sightlines between pedestrians attempting to cross and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle obstruction
hazards.description: A vehicle stopped at the curb creates a visual barrier between the sidewalk and the travel lane.

hazards.name: Unmarked roadway
hazards.description: Lack of lane markings may result in unpredictable vehicle positioning relative to the curb.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Warning
hazards.description: The mid-block crossing is marked but lacks signage or signals to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: At the marked crosswalk in the mid-ground

hazards.name: Large metal plate in roadway
hazards.description: A large metal utility plate is positioned in the travel lane, creating a trip hazard for pedestrians and a potential slip hazard in wet conditions.

hazards.name: Wide multi-lane crossing
hazards.description: The roadway consists of at least four travel lanes with no visible pedestrian refuge or marked crossing, increasing exposure time to high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the entire width of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parallel parked cars along the right curb can obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to enter the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the curb

hazards.name: Unprotected Driveway Crossing
hazards.description: A wide driveway/access point crosses the sidewalk without clear markings or physical priority for pedestrians, creating a conflict zone with vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center background where the black car is positioned.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There is no clearly marked pedestrian crossing visible in the immediate vicinity despite the presence of large buildings and potential foot traffic.

hazards.name: Drainage gap trip hazard
hazards.description: A narrow drainage gap or damaged section at the curb/sidewalk interface could catch wheels or cause a trip.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom left foreground at the curb line

hazards.name: High Speed Environment
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes can encourage drivers to exceed safe urban speeds, particularly during off-peak hours.

hazards.name: Lack of crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or curb ramps are visible for pedestrians needing to cross the adjacent roadway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light, improving visibility and priority.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard parallel line markings with continental or ladder-style markings for better visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow them to slow traffic and provide space for protected bicycle infrastructure.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with RRFB
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Bus Bulbs
interventions.description: Implementing bus bulbs would allow buses to stop in the travel lane, preventing them from pulling over and potentially blocking sightlines or sidewalk space.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or physical barrier between the sidewalk and the roadway to increase separation from large vehicles.

interventions.title: Mid-block Signalized Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a HAWK signal or full traffic signal with a marked crosswalk to provide a safe crossing point on this long block.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (HAWK)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to provide a protected phase for pedestrians to cross the multi-lane road.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace the faint transverse lines with high-visibility continental or ladder markings.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing and Striping
interventions.description: Resurface the degraded roadway and add clear lane markings to organize traffic flow and discourage speeding on the wide street.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Repurpose a portion of the wide roadway for protected bike lanes to narrow travel lanes and provide a greater buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian-activated signal or RRFB to provide a safe crossing point for the active building frontage.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow vehicle speeds and reduce the overall crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Reallocate road space for a protected bike lane to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and motor vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at the mid-block crossing.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated and legal crossing point for pedestrians accessing the large building.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk with RRFB
interventions.description: Adding a high-visibility marked crosswalk with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons would provide a designated and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Marked Driveway Crossing
interventions.description: Use high-visibility pavement markings or a continuous sidewalk material across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk and a raised median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon
interventions.description: Install a HAWK signal or RRFB to provide a protected crossing phase for pedestrians at this high-volume location.

interventions.title: Curb-side Buffer
interventions.description: Install bollards or additional planters along the curb edge to provide a physical barrier between the wide pedestrian plaza and the roadway.

interventions.title: Drainage Grate Maintenance
interventions.description: Ensure the drainage gap at the curb is covered with a pedestrian-safe, flush-mounted grate.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and alert drivers to potential crossings.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide accessible transitions between the plaza and the roadway.
